question: Which flowers may be used as offerings in this ritual procedure?
premises: Flowers of āragvadha may be used.
Alternatively, other flowers may be used.
Flowers born of the bakula tree are specified as an option.
inference: The ritual may use āragvadha flowers or flowers born of the bakula.
plain_english: One may use flowers of āragvadha or flowers born of the bakula.
